mr_title: Polish 'Fix inconsistent ordering of config imports'

expected_issues.title: Config location properties lose per-location reverse-order precedence
expected_issues.description:
All locations of spring.config.location / spring.config.additional-location are now grouped into one contributor in declaration order, instead of one contributor per location added in reverse order, which changes which file overrides which.

The previous code iterated `for (i = locations.length - 1; i >= 0; i--)` and created one initial contributor per location, so later locations take precedence over earlier ones. The polish creates a single contributor from List.of(locations), losing the reverse ordering: with `spring.config.location=classpath:a.yml,file:./override.yml`, values from override.yml no longer win. Only spring.config.import may be grouped; location properties must keep per-location, reverse-order registration.
